result.reason: The operative indemnity reaches the preferred position: Contractor defends and indemnifies Company and its affiliates against third-party IP, legal-compliance, Contractor-caused data-incident, and gross-negligence/wilful-misconduct claims, with notice, defense control, cooperation, and settlement protections. It also appropriately carves the indemnity and related attorneys’ fees out of the existing limitations. No broader Customer indemnity is added. However, the unchanged non-infringement warranty is unnecessarily relocated ahead of the Section 7 heading, leaving the section disordered, and the title still incorrectly refers to “Indemnification of Contractor.” The notice provision also lacks the customary qualification that delayed notice relieves Contractor only to the extent materially prejudiced.
